performance.overall_assessment:
Verdict and review limits: No new material finding or concrete severe server/runtime performance blocker is established by the embedded package. The current selection correction substantively addresses SEC-R35-01 and ADH-R35-01 without adding backend work. This assessment uses only the supplied source, diffs, evidence and recorded resolutions; no tools, execution or independent hash verification were performed.

Scope and adherence: The r35-to-current delta is confined to the three admitted Web files and the diagnostic changes in the final API session test. The product correction preserves D07/D08 by determining omitted-resource retention from current reducer ownership rather than request-start selection. The product catalogue action no longer declares or reads a selected-resource hint. Structurally extra stale hints in pure test fixtures therefore exercise their rejection rather than establish a shipped compatibility path. Seller submission, backend validation and eligibility authority, immutable operation/ACK semantics, observational GETs, explicit recovery and the separate Channel capability remain unchanged. No renewed scope approval is indicated by this bounded correction.

Performance: Selection events add constant-size identity metadata to the existing reducer. Catalogue adoption builds a temporary index, reconciles incoming items and, when necessary, searches loaded observations for the selected resource. These passes scale with entries explicitly loaded by the user; they do not fetch a catalogue to locate an exact entity. Retention adds at most the selected observation to the existing individual slice. No additional HTTP, automatic refresh, provider fan-out, persistent cache, request loop or scheduler reconciliation is introduced. Existing page accumulation and repeated rendering searches retain their local costs, but this delta establishes no severe regression warranting their reopening.

Backend access paths: The supplied source and current PostgreSQL plans preserve parent pagination before child hydration. First, deep and last pages perform operation probes only for the returned 20 or 50 drafts; the beyond-last page performs zero child probes. Detail hydration remains one bounded statement over at most 11 operations and 10 receipts each. Catalogue hydration uses one statement with at most 50 indexed context/resource probes, rather than application-level N+1 requests or catalogue walking. Saved-observation projection uses direct current/historical lookups. Exact counts, deep OFFSET work and sequential writes for a bounded catalogue page retain their disclosed costs. The synthetic 1,000-draft/10,000-receipt evidence supports these access-path conclusions, not production capacity. Unchanged submission/reconciliation budgets and omitted unchanged methods are carried through the supplied baseline assurance; they were not independently reverified in full here.

Concurrency and runtime evidence: Both current template FRC markers originate in the browser main workflow. The direct phase records 100 real BFF requests, 99 safe 202 responses and one completed provider-list leader. The separate UI phase records 100 attempts coalesced into one BFF refresh, ending PAUSED and ineligible in both views. The BCI marker records 100 independent actor/account intents without quota bypass; it must not be represented as 100 successful contending submissions on one account. Same-account contention and uncertainty protections retain their separate carried PostgreSQL evidence. The five-group RLS stage demonstrates bounded concurrent functional outcomes and expected effect counts, not saturation, sustained load or production latency guarantees. Formal pcv-1 disposition remains pending and cannot be inferred from marker presence or aggregate passing counts alone.

Elegance and structural soundness: The small pure reducer remains proportionate to the demonstrated cross-slice dependency. Selected identity is ownership metadata rather than another observation store. All 12 draft-state commit sites have corresponding selection establishment or clearing: BU/channel changes, opening, variation/new draft, save/create/resumed creation, submit, automatic recovery hydration, manual recovery and operation consultation. Async commits retain their applicable context/editor/request guards. Selected identity is established even without a saved observation; clearing erases it. Catalogue completion retains only the current selected resource's highest known observation while preserving exact returned membership and cursor metadata. Existing common-versus-draft proof, historical-context precedence and conservative failure semantics remain intact. No general framework or broader component refactor is necessary for this delivery.

Operational fit and carried debt: Operational fit remains mixed because the accepted limitations remain real. OPS-R4-01 stays closed as nonblocking conservative availability debt under foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-failure-observation-authority: delayed failure may withdraw local availability from newer passive evidence while preserving its facts, with explicit successful refresh as recovery. The unchanged failure semantics provide no reopening basis. SEC-R6-04 remains restricted to the private local cohort under foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-recovery-read-budget before untrusted/public admission or Railway. Original feature test-after/unknown provenance remains recorded. Operator-confirmed credential containment is accepted with its stated historical limits; reconfirmation or retesting is unnecessary.

Validation and readiness: The current r41 receipt reports exit 0 and 802 cases: 284 API unit, 398 PostgreSQL, 45 Web unit and 75 Playwright, comprising 74 browser cases and one pure consumer case. It supplies current source/runtime/served attribution, 38 source matches, 30 protected seals, three unchanged HEADs and all five template markers. The two new real-BFF sequences verify cleared selection and switched-B retention; the pure tests additionally cover page-only selection. r36 establishes only the reached pure causal failures, not browser RED. The r38 counter correction preserves expected cardinality and uses the fixture's normal request record. API diagnostics preserve provider-entry-before-invalidation, six 401 responses, the ADMIN 403 response, unchanged observation snapshots and genuine cleanup. Passing r40/r41 does not attribute or prove correction of the historical r39 timeout. Preserved TEST migrations/activation, actual Meta compatibility and assisted submission/status, module consolidation and fresh final review remain outstanding. Delivery correctly remains Pending.

test-quality.overall_assessment:
Assessment: acceptable candidate test quality; no new material test-quality finding.

Delta alignment: the current reducer and browser tests address the actual selected-editor/omitted-page regressions identified in r35. The r36 pure causal RED reached all three intended reducer failures; r41 then passed the new pure and real-BFF browser sequences. The session-test diagnostic addition improves failure observability without weakening its existing authorization, snapshot, or cleanup assertions.

Assertion effectiveness and efficiency: assertions verify exact page membership/cursor, selected-resource ownership, PAUSED/ineligible state, persisted fences, provider-call cardinality, session/role denial, unchanged observation snapshots, and final DOM. They are not status-only in substance. The 10-second waits are tied to the declared debounce/lease behavior and are paired with held-response and effect assertions; the 14.3-minute browser lane is costly but proportionate to this real-BFF/real-PostgreSQL race surface.

Topology and matrix: `bash scripts/test-channels-local.sh all` passed at r41 with 284 API unit, 398 PostgreSQL, 45 Web unit, and 75 Playwright cases (802 total). Browser coverage uses real session, CSRF, BFF, Prisma, disposable PostgreSQL, and a source-to-served fresh bundle; only the external provider/SDK boundary is fixture-controlled. API and persistence, reducer, browser critical journey, FRC 100-BFF and 100-UI-attempt probes, DI boundary, and source-served checks are evidenced. Hosted CI, preserved-TEST activation, actual Meta behavior, and production capacity are correctly not claimed.

Fail-first and bypass review: original feature provenance remains honestly test-after/unknown under TQA-ST05-03. The later selected-owner correction has bounded causal RED evidence; authored browser scenarios are not mislabeled as browser RED. No skip/focus marker, test-only product route, mock fallback around BFF, auth shortcut, ambient fixture selection, test-only DI token substitution, or silent contract fallback is evidenced. The session diagnostic fails loudly on early HTTP completion, rejection, or its native deadline while retaining actual request settlement and cleanup.

Decision adherence: D01-D09, CR-01, CR-02, AR-V11-01, AR-V11-02, AR-V11-03, and CR-V11-01 are adherent for this changed scope, based on the current tests plus carried unchanged producer evidence. OPS-R4-01, SEC-R6-04, and TQA-ST05-03 remain recorded nonblocking debt/limits and are not reopened.

Gate readiness: candidate assurance evidence is sufficient for this test-quality lane. Preserved local TEST preflight and migrations, source-bound activation, assisted real-Meta submit/status proof, formal PCV disposition, and fresh final review remain mandatory before delivery.
